text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm passing by the outdoor
stage...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Like a swan, I am beauty and might
defined!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Whew. Perhaps those steps were too magnificent.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Not a single soul has arrived to watch
me, but the
mere thought of the crowd
crying out my name
sends chills down my
spine...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Could it be?! Have you come to see
my
performance?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Uh, actually, I'm just passing throu—

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! There is no need to
explain! You
undoubtedly caught a
glimpse of me and found
yourself utterly
entranced!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I was practicing my post-race victory
pose! Your
reaction is nothing short of
natural!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What did you think? Do you believe it
to be a
performance befitting the
effervescence that
suffuses a venue after
a race?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
I think just running a victory lap would be
better...

text_block_list.text:
What did you think? Do you believe it
to be a
performance befitting the
effervescence that
suffuses a venue after
a race?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
I think just running a victory lap would be
better...

text_block_list.text:
A victory lap? Me, the winner, running
alone on
the track like the wind...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I see! Yes, that sounds perfectly
splendid!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
With that victory lap, I shall carve the
strength
and beauty of the Overlord into
the minds of all!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I shall start
practicing at
once! So commences my
victory lap etude!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Exactly! I knew it was
brilliant!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The glorious poses I display on the turf
are what
set me apart as the Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now then, time to bring things to a true
fever
pitch! Come, don't just stand there!
Cheer me on!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I end up watching Т.М. Опера О practice
her
posing for quite some time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О takes her leave while
waving
goodbye to an imaginary
audience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
